description: UNFCCC KCI socio-economic impact case study corpus for Policy Impact Engine

cases.title: Assessing climate and socio-economic effects of agricultural credit policies: Brazil
cases.summary: Directed agricultural credit increases farm productivity and rural employment with land-use and equity trade-offs.

cases.title: Understanding the Implications of the Energy Transition on African Economies: Economy and Jobs
cases.summary: Renewable energy deployment creates jobs and GDP gains but requires workforce transition and grid investment.

cases.title: The impacts and incentives inherent in destination-based carbon pricing: India
cases.summary: Destination-based carbon pricing shifts industrial behaviour with competitiveness and public revenue effects.

cases.title: Impacts of domestic and global response measures: Maldives
cases.summary: Climate response measures affect tourism-dependent small island economies with trade and fiscal spillovers.
